---
title: "TAOOH — preparation"
subtitle: "Observed weekly histories and patient-level covariates"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(mostr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "taooh.R"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
stopifnot(horizon_days %% 7 == 0)
horizon_weeks <- as.integer(horizon_days / 7)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "results")
figure_dir <- here(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-and-restrict
#| include: false

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  as.data.frame()

taooh <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet")
) |>
  as.data.frame()

# Validation also checks that every observed state is in 1:5.
validate_taooh_follow_up(taooh, cohort)

taooh <- taooh |>
  filter(week <= horizon_weeks)

cohort <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    ecog_fstcnt = if_else(ecog_fstcnt == 4L, 3L, ecog_fstcnt),
    diagnosis = fct_lump_n(
      factor(diagnosis),
      n = 4,
      other_level = "Other",
      ties.method = "first"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: empirical-state-occupancy
#| include: false

state_labels <- c(
  "Alive/out of hospital",
  "Planned admission",
  "Emergency room",
  "Unplanned admission",
  "Dead"
)

empirical_sop_data <- cohort |>
  select(id, tx) |>
  left_join(taooh_carry_death_forward(taooh, horizon_days), by = "id") |>
  filter(week >= 1L) |>
  mutate(
    y_taooh = factor(y_taooh, levels = 1:5, labels = state_labels),
    tx = group_factor(tx)
  )

empirical_sop_plot <- plot_sops(
  empirical_sop_data,
  time_var = "week",
  y_var = "y_taooh",
  facet_var = NULL,
  linetype_var = "tx"
) +
  scale_colour_state() +
  scale_fill_state() +
  scale_linetype_group() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Week after random selection",
    y = "State occupancy probability",
    colour = "TAOOH state",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  empirical_sop_plot,
  here(figure_dir, "empirical-state-occupancy.png"),
  height = 5
)
```

- Baseline weeks -1 and 0 supply the lags for week 1
- Patients without an analysable week are dropped from all later steps

```{r}
#| label: build-analysis-data
#| include: false

analysis_data <- cohort |>
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    age,
    gender,
    diagnosis,
    ecog_fstcnt,
    albumin,
    bilirubin,
    c_reactive_protein,
    lactate_dehydrogenase,
    survival_time_days,
    event_death
  ) |>
  left_join(taooh, by = "id") |>
  arrange(id, week) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  mutate(
    y = as.integer(y_taooh),
    yprev = if_else(week - lag(week) == 1L, lag(y), NA_integer_),
    ypprev = if_else(week - lag(week, 2L) == 2L, lag(y, 2L), NA_integer_)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(
    week >= 1L,
    !is.na(y),
    !is.na(yprev),
    !is.na(ypprev),
    yprev != 5L,
    ypprev != 5L
  ) |>
  select(-y_taooh)

# mostr's default first follow-up time (week 1) must be in the model data.
stopifnot(min(analysis_data$week) == 1L)

write_parquet(
  analysis_data,
  here(results_dir, "prepared.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```
